title: CustomPromptPage Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the Cognos Analytics CustomPromptPage control. Defines button groups, prompt types, presets, and multilingual labels for the drag-and-drop prompt page interface.

selectFirstGroupExpanded.description: If true, the first button group is auto-expanded on load. Overridden by each group's own defaultExpanded.

presets.description: Quick-load preset buttons that auto-create cards for a predefined set of parameters.

label.description: Fallback display label if locale not matched.

labels.description: Localized labels keyed by 2-letter locale code (e.g. 'de', 'en').

description.description: Tooltip or description shown on the preset button.

parameters.description: List of paramNames to auto-load. Each must match a button's paramName in buttonGroups.

buttonGroups.description: Top-level array of button groups. Each group becomes a collapsible section in the left pane.

localizedString.description: Object with 2-letter locale codes as keys and translated strings as values.

groupLabel.description: Fallback label for the group header.

groupIcon.description: Inline SVG string for the group header icon.

defaultExpanded.description: Whether this group is expanded on initial load.

groupItems.description: Mixed array of subgroups and/or standalone buttons.

subgroup.description: A collapsible subgroup containing related buttons.

defaultExpanded.description: Whether subgroup is expanded on load.

button.description: A single prompt button configuration. The required properties depend on promptType.

helpText.description: Fallback help text shown on the card below the header.

required.description: If true, card auto-renders on load and cannot be removed.

promptType.description: Determines input UI and parameter handling. 'value' = bubble input with optional autocomplete. 'text' = bubble input without autocomplete. 'date' = single date picker. 'dateRange' = FROM/TO pickers, single parameter with start/end. 'dateFromTo' = FROM/TO pickers, two separate parameters. 'searchSelect' = on-demand search via hidden native Cognos Search & Select prompt.

paramName.description: Cognos parameter name. Required for all types EXCEPT dateFromTo (which uses paramNames).

paramNames.description: Required ONLY for dateFromTo. Two separate parameter names.

queryName.description: Name of the DataStore query providing autocomplete values. Used with promptType 'value'.

useColumn.description: Column index in query results for the 'use' value sent to Cognos.

displayColumn.description: Column index for the 'display' value shown to user. Defaults to useColumn.

dateFormat.description: Informational hint for expected date format (e.g. 'yyyy-MM-dd').

sspBlockName.description: Required for searchSelect. The 'lid' of the hidden Cognos block containing the native Search & Select prompt.

useValueLength.description: For searchSelect: number of leading characters from the result string used as the 'use' value. If omitted, full string is used.
